# Vieo & ClauseOS Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We, as members, contributors, and maintainers of the **Vieo** (`vieo-ai`) and **ClauseOS** (`clause.os` / `cx`) ecosystem, pledge to make participation in our repositories, curriculum portals (`vieo.ai`), and community channels a harassment-free experience for everyone—regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, caste, color, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

We pledge to act and interact in ways that sustain an open, welcoming, sovereign, and disciplined engineering community.

## Our Standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment for our community include:

- Using welcoming, clear, and inclusive language
- Being respectful of differing viewpoints, backgrounds, and technical experiences
- Offering and accepting constructive, evidence-grounded technical criticism gracefully
- Upholding architectural stewardship, creator sovereignty, and what is best for the community
- Showing empathy and professionalism toward fellow contributors and learners

Examples of unacceptable behavior include:

- The use of sexualized language or imagery, and sexual attention or advances of any kind
- Trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, and personal or political attacks
- Public or private harassment
- Publishing others' private information—such as physical addresses, electronic addresses, credentials, or private keys—without explicit permission
- Deliberately introducing malicious code, path-leak exploits, or license violations into the repository or plugin ecosystem
- Other conduct which could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional engineering setting

## Enforcement Responsibilities

Project maintainers and community leaders are responsible for clarifying and enforcing our standards of acceptable behavior and will take appropriate, fair, and proportionate corrective action in response to any behavior deemed inappropriate, threatening, offensive, or harmful.

Maintainers have the right and responsibility to remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, pull requests, wiki edits, issues, and other contributions that are not aligned with this Code of Conduct, and will communicate reasons for moderation decisions when appropriate.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies across all **Vieo** and **ClauseOS** community spaces—including `vieo-ai/clause.os`, first-party `cx-*` plugin repositories, `vieo.ai` curriculum channels, Discord servers, and issue trackers—and also applies when an individual is officially representing the project or community in public spaces (such as using an official `@vieo.ai` address, posting via an official account, or acting as an appointed representative at online or offline events).

## Enforcement & Reporting

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported to the maintainers responsible for enforcement at **[abuse@vieo.ai](mailto:abuse@vieo.ai)**. All complaints will be reviewed and investigated promptly and fairly, and maintainers are obligated to respect the privacy and security of the reporter of any incident.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1, tailored for the **Vieo** and **ClauseOS** open-source community.
